n, k = map(int, input().split())
p = list(map(float, input().split()))

res = [0.0] * n
dp = [0.0] * (1 << n)
cnt = [0] * (1 << n)

for mask in range(1, 1 << n):
    cnt[mask] = bin(mask).count('1')

dp[0] = 1.0

for mask in range(1 << n):
    sum_p = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        if not (mask & (1 << i)):
            sum_p += p[i]
    if sum_p < 1e-12:
        continue
    for i in range(n):
        if not (mask & (1 << i)):
            prob = p[i] / sum_p
            if cnt[mask] < k:
                res[i] += dp[mask] * prob
            dp[mask | (1 << i)] += dp[mask] * prob

print(' '.join(f"{x:.12f}" for x in res))
